drafts.contract: One row per observed day/source; complete source history before current UTC day; reported priced USD subset and missingness counts. Does not manufacture absent dates.

One row per observed day/component/raw classification/official classification. Official method assigns protocol fees to public; raw attribution remains unestablished. Missing/invalid finite-value guards; no zero fill.
Token/day/source/blockchain/symbol candidate grain. Detect repeated non-null and positive balances before summation; do not automatically MAX deduplicate.
One row per observed day/source. Monetary result withheld for repeated non-null balance keys or invalid numeric rows; priced subset otherwise.
Compact source-level quality result using same token-day audit CTE as37. Repeated-key, invalid and unpriced counts; source history boundaries.

filters_and_limits: End at previous completed UTC day. Source freshness must be displayed; last table row is not evidence all components complete.
No user count sum across token, source, chain or date. uniq_accounts windows overlap; official canonical total query needed.
No automatic summation of swaps across assets until repeated-token/swap-leg grain is verified.
Volume asset double-leg convention remains unverified. Do not divide by two or label unique economic turnover.

Public and confidential dimensions are provider classifications. Their balances require scope reconciliation before economic total is asserted. Gross-fee official method specifically hardcodes protocol fees as public; this is not independently observed privacy attribution.
TVL SQL guards repeats, but verified technical uniqueness does not prove economically disjoint custody claims.
SUM ignores missing values: results explicitly priced subset, not complete notional.
No source-price backfill: query33 mismatches reported USD against quantity times source daily price in 13095/14452 confidential and 45816/51997 public comparable rows.
267 positive-token unpriced observations differ from 216139 rows with neither volume field; sparse fields are not zero activity.
Gross accrued fees, wallet receipt sweeps, partner payouts, token purchases and burns are separate ledgers. Cash receipts may exceed fees on sweep days.
No verified DefiLlama Intents TVL adapter found; official Dune TVL query is the primary reconciliation target.
value_capture_next: Use matched complete windows to compare reported fees / reported priced volume as observed gross fee intensity in bps, with independent numerator and denominator scope coverage.
Retained USD wallet receipts / accrued gross USD fees is a cash realization comparison over matched windows, not daily take rate; test 7/30/90-day lag alignment and receipt concentration.
Report rolling fee medians and top-five-day fee share alongside totals to expose spike dependence, using observed days and explicit missing-day completeness.
Intents balances / volume is a stock-flow comparison only after source-specific custody and swap-leg scope are verified; never imply revenue or executable liquidity.
Do not infer genuine unique users, net deposits, executed buybacks or token burns from these aggregated source fields.

official_fee_classification.evidence: Lead inspected official SQL in Dune UI; fragments below preserve supplied text, not a claim to full SQL export.
official_fee_classification.protocol_fragment: SELECT date_at, 'protocol fee' AS referral, 'public' AS source_type, CAST(amount_fee AS double) AS fee FROM dune.near.dataset_near_intents_protocol_fees WHERE date_at < current_date
official_fee_classification.affiliate_fragment: SELECT date_at, referral, source_type, CAST(fee AS double) AS fee FROM dune.near.dataset_near_intents_fees
official_fee_classification.aggregation: Official SQL UNIONs protocol and affiliate components then aggregates positive fees by public/confidential source_type. Protocol public attribution is a SQL literal, not observed raw privacy metadata.
official_fee_classification.implementation: SQL36 retains source_type=unattributed_protocol and adds official_source_type=public for protocol. Affiliate official_source_type follows source_type. SQL36 keeps zero observations and invalid/missing diagnostics; positive fee totals align numerically with positive-only aggregation when no negatives are admitted.
